entries.title: Proverbs 25:1
segments:
. 
 
    1. The character of these proverbs sustains the title (see (unresolved link)). 
 
    also--refers to the former part of the book. 
 
    copied out--literally, "transferred," that is, from some other book to this; not given from memory.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:2
segments: 2. God's unsearchableness impresses us with awe (compare
). But kings, being finite, should confer with wise counsellors;

entries.title: Proverbs 25:3
segments: 3. Ye wisely keeping state secrets, which to common men are as inaccessible heights and depths.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:4
segments: 4, 5. As separating impurities from ore leaves pure silver, so taking from a king wicked counsellors leaves a wise and beneficent government.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:5
segments: 5. before--or, "in presence of," as courtiers stood about a king.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:6
segments: 6, 7. Do not intrude into the presence of the king, for the elevation of the humble is honorable, but the humbling of the proud disgraceful (

entries.title: Proverbs 25:8
segments: 8. (Compare

). 
 
    lest ... shame--lest you do what you ought not, when shamed by defeat, or "lest thou art shut out from doing any thing."

entries.title: Proverbs 25:9
segments: 9, 10. (Compare

, Margin). 
 
    secret--that is, of your opponent, for his disadvantage, and so you be disgraced, not having discussed your difficulties with him.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:11
segments:
11. a word fitly--literally, "quickly," as wheels roll, just in time. The comparison as apples ... silver gives a like sense. 
 
    apples, &c.--either real apples of golden color, in a silver network basket, or imitations on silver embroidery.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:12
segments: 12. Those who desire to know and do rightly, most highly esteem good counsel (
). The listening ear is better than one hung with gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:13
segments: 13. Snow from mountains was used to cool drinks; so refreshing is a faithful messenger (

entries.title: Proverbs 25:14
segments: 14. clouds--literally, "vapors" (

), clouds only in appearance. 
 
    a false gift--promised, but not given.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:15
segments:
15. Gentleness and kindness overcome the most powerful and obstinate. 
 
    long forbearing--or, "slowness to anger" (

entries.title: Proverbs 25:16
segments: 16, 17. A comparison, as a surfeit of honey produces physical disgust, so your company, however agreeable in moderation, may, if excessive, lead your friend to hate you.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:18
segments: 18. A false witness is as destructive to reputation, as such weapons to the body (

). 
 
    beareth ... witness--literally, "answereth questions," as before a judge, against his neighbor.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:19
segments: 19. Treachery annoys as well as deceives.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:20
segments: 20. Not only is the incongruity of songs (that is, joyful) and sadness meant, but an accession of sadness, by want of sympathy, is implied.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:21
segments: 21, 22. (Compare
). As metals are melted by heaping coals upon them, so is the heart softened by kindness.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:23
segments: 23. Better, "As the north wind bringeth forth (
) or produces rain, so does a concealed or slandering tongue produce anger."

    good news--that is, of some loved interest or absent friend, the more grateful as coming from afar.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:26
segments: 26. From troubled fountains and corrupt springs no healthy water is to be had, so when the righteous are oppressed by the wicked, their power for good is lessened or destroyed.

); so men who are self-glorious find shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 25:28
segments: 28. Such are exposed to the incursions of evil thoughts and successful temptations.
